sanitization: Only known local build/temp paths are replaced in JSON reports; command paths use placeholders. Normal/optimized logs are byte-identical. Original and published hashes record integrity. No source hash, result, signal, tested SHA or failure identity changed.
limits: Catchable SIGTERM/SIGINT after CLI handlers install; no SIGKILL, power-loss or OS-forced termination cleanup guarantee.
Owned POSIX local Nginx and stdlib loopback fixtures only; no public TLS, Discord, GoDaddy or production acceptance.
Actual Docker unavailable. Cancellation around create is simulated; reconciliation refuses foreign/unknown ownership and reports cleanup failure rather than deleting unverified resources.
Source worker cleanup relies on subprocess.run exception unwind killing/reaping its owned child, verified by Linux process introspection.
Windows capability simulation only; Windows forced TerminateProcess is outside catchable POSIX signal guarantees.
No approval, merge, native specification acceptance, persistence/restore, capacity or security certification. Fresh whole-head review required.
